summary.headline: Bologna Codices 2280 and 3632
summary.text: Description of Bologna University Library codex 2280, including Ptolemy’s Geography and Harmonics, an anonymous commentary on the Tetrabiblos, Porphyry’s introduction to Ptolemy’s apotelesmatic work, Demophilus-related scholia, and astrological diagrams of the zodiac and trigonic radiations. The entry then begins codex 3632, a richly illustrated manuscript of miscellaneous excerpts, including astronomical tables and a paschal cycle.
